# Independent RPM upstream metadata

The `repodata/` files were generated by Fedora 42 `createrepo_c` 1.2.0-3.fc42
from the genuine `internal/format/rpm/testdata/artifactweave-alpha-1.0-1.fc42.noarch.rpm`
(SHA-256 `29a5f52063f96c5462c1d8fb54e88c30fbe90dd8783a03c74e5e52f1ec778a85`).
They were not produced by artifactweave. Fedora's default primary compression
is zstd, which exercises a real remote metadata variant.

To regenerate, place that RPM in `pool/` under a temporary repository root and
run `createrepo_c --no-database --revision 1700000000 <repository-root>` in the
pinned Fedora 42 acceptance image, then copy its `repodata/` files here. The
revision is fixed; the metadata timestamps reflect the regeneration time.
